name: Endocrinology & diabetes (category guide)
summary: Thyroid / PCOS / diabetes pathways — polyclinic chronic care vs private endo, foreigner fee honesty, and why ‘hormone clinics’ are not the same specialty.
body: Endocrinology covers diabetes, thyroid, PCOS, and other hormone disorders. Citizens/PRs often stay in polyclinic chronic programmes with hospital endo referral when needed; foreigners pay full public fees, so private endocrinology mainly buys speed and continuity in English. Start with a GP for HbA1c, thyroid panels, and medication refills before a specialist package. Boutique ‘hormone optimisation’ clinics are not automatic substitutes for SMC Endocrinology — ask registration and what labs justify ongoing scripts. Corporate outpatient riders may cover specialist consults with referral while chronic meds sit outside the outpatient bucket. Distinct from men’s-health urology hormone sales. Category guide, not a ranked endo list.
